description: EX-PUBLIC and TXN-LOCAL with several DBEngine objects in one process (not yet asked). e1 is the usual CreateObject engine, e2 comes from a raw CoCreateInstance (CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER, IDispatch) and e3 from ITypeInfo::CreateInstance of the coclass. Each reads Workspaces.Count and Workspaces(0).Name; e1 opens the main copy exclusive read/write, then e2 and e3 open it shared and exclusive (Errors of each engine read right before and after); e1, e2 and e3 each BeginTrans on their Workspaces(0) and update V of row 1, row 1 and row 64 (dbFailOnError); each resolves. A final fresh open reads. Asks whether the engine objects are one engine (shared sessions, in-process admission, 3188) or independent engines (3045/3260).
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-cat-txn-lock probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
